newsitem.title: USA: JAX International purchase applications up.
newsitem.headline: JAX International purchase applications up.

text.p: JAX International Inc said on Tuesday it had accepted 102 purchase applications for its projected 90 lot development, Woodview Heights, in Tulsa, Okla., exceeding the company's expectations.
The applications total just shy of $6 million, JAX said in a statement.

"We already have approvals for first mortgages on 40 of those applications totaling over $2 million, and we've already signed 20 contracts totaling more than $1.1 million," said Verna Howard, a marketing specialist with the project.
The Woodview Heights subdivision will build single family homes priced from $46,990 to $59,990, the company said.
The company added that it should be ready to break ground and start building within the next 30 days.
JAX International is a developer of affordable homes.
